h1: Home Staging in Beverly Hills, CA
intro: Beverly Hills is a market where listing photos compete with the best-presented homes anywhere, and Aviara Design Co. stages to that standard. We travel from our Temecula studio to stage the hedge-lined streets of the Flats, the single-story view homes of Trousdale Estates, and the canyon properties of Benedict Canyon, Coldwater Canyon, and Beverly Hills Post Office. Restraint, scale, and light are the whole job here.
marketContext: Beverly Hills is a global luxury market whose housing stock sorts itself by geography. The Flats hold wide streets, deep lots, and traditional, Spanish, and Georgian estates beside new contemporaries behind tall hedges. Above Sunset, Trousdale Estates is mid-century and contemporary living on view lots. Beverly Hills Post Office, Benedict Canyon, Coldwater Canyon, and Beverly Crest add canyon privacy, and condos on the edges of the Golden Triangle give the city its entry point.

The buyer pool is international, entertainment, and finance, and it compares your listing with the most carefully presented homes it has seen. These buyers have walked through gallery-grade interiors in London, New York, and Dubai, and they read a room quickly: art scale, lighting, the quality of the sofa. Many meet the home first through an advisor or a video, which raises the stakes on every frame.

The spread runs from condos south of Wilshire to eight-figure estates in the Flats and Trousdale, and the staging vocabulary shifts with it. A Trousdale rebuild wants low, long furniture, sculptural lighting, and almost nothing on the walls except the view. A traditional Flats estate wants layered rooms at real scale. The common thread is restraint. These buyers are not impressed by more, they are impressed by right.
whyStaging: Beverly Hills listings are seen first as photographs by buyers, advisors, and family offices around the world. The staging has to hold up at gallery scale, because that is this audience's standard.

A Trousdale view home, a Flats estate, and a Benedict Canyon retreat are three different architectural problems. Staging that understands the specific house, rather than a generic luxury look, reads as credible here.
Buyers here are deciding whether a home feels considered, not whether it feels furnished. Restraint, correct scale, and statement lighting do more for a Beverly Hills listing than volume ever will.
localProof: We travel from our Temecula studio for Beverly Hills projects and hold walkthroughs in person or virtually. Our estate and livable-luxury work across Southern California translates directly to the scale and restraint these listings require, and the portfolio shows the standard.

serviceNotes.name: Vacant Home Staging
serviceNotes.note: The usual route for an estate emptied for sale, a Trousdale rebuild delivered unfurnished, or a Flats property held in trust. We bring inventory at estate scale, large-format art, sculptural lighting, and long, low seating for the view rooms.

serviceNotes.name: Occupied Home Staging
serviceNotes.note: Common for long-held Flats and Beverly Hills Post Office homes with owners in residence and significant furnishings. We edit, rearrange, and supplement discreetly so the home photographs at its full tier, working around staff schedules and private showings.

serviceNotes.name: Interior Design
serviceNotes.note: For homeowners furnishing a new Trousdale contemporary, warming up a Flats traditional, or settling into a canyon home in Benedict or Coldwater. Livable luxury here means rooms that feel collected rather than decorated, and a palette that lets the architecture lead.

serviceNotes.name: Staging Consultations
serviceNotes.note: A focused walkthrough for Beverly Hills listing agents and sellers weighing how far to go before photography. We prioritize the moves that matter for the property and the competing inventory it will sit beside.

commonMistakes.title: Staging a Trousdale view home like a traditional estate
commonMistakes.body: Trousdale Estates was built around single-level living and glass, and the view is the product. Tall case goods, heavy drapery, and busy art layering fight the windows. The right move is low, long furniture, a quiet palette, and lighting that reads as sculpture, so the eye goes straight through to the city.

commonMistakes.title: Treating restraint as emptiness
commonMistakes.body: Beverly Hills buyers expect editing, not vacancy. A minimal room only works when the few pieces in it are right in scale, material, and placement, with art sized to the architecture. A half-furnished estate with small art and token accessories reads as unfinished, and at this tier that costs the listing credibility.

commonMistakes.title: Forgetting how the home will actually be seen
commonMistakes.body: Many Beverly Hills buyers meet a property through an advisor, a video walkthrough, or a brochure before they visit. The sightline from the entry, the first frame of every room, and the way rooms connect on camera matter more than any single vignette. We plan the staging around that sequence, from the motor court to the primary suite.

faqs.question: How much does home staging cost in Beverly Hills?
faqs.answer: It depends on the scale of the home. A condo south of Wilshire, a Flats traditional, and a Trousdale contemporary call for different inventory, art, and install time. We quote after a walkthrough, in person or over video, so the proposal fits the actual property.

faqs.question: Do you stage Trousdale Estates and other view homes in Beverly Hills?
faqs.answer: Yes, and they are the projects we are most built for. View homes in Trousdale and along the canyon rims need furniture that stays below the sightline, a restrained palette, and lighting with real form. The house should read as a frame for the city.

faqs.question: Can you stage Beverly Hills homes that are still being lived in?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many Beverly Hills listings are long-held family homes with substantial furnishings and art, and our occupied staging edits and supplements what is there rather than clearing it out. We work around household staff, security, and showing schedules.

faqs.question: Do you serve Bel Air, Holmby Hills, and the rest of the Westside?
faqs.answer: Yes. We travel from our Temecula studio for projects across Beverly Hills, Beverly Hills Post Office, Bel Air, Holmby Hills, West Hollywood, and Brentwood, and we schedule installs so the drive never shows in the work. Walkthroughs happen in person or virtually.

faqs.question: How quickly can you stage a Beverly Hills listing?
faqs.answer: A Beverly Hills project can usually be installed within a couple of weeks of a signed agreement, with estate-scale homes needing a little longer for inventory and delivery. If the timeline is tight, tell us at the first call and we will be straight about what is possible.
